title: The Windows 95 startup sound was written by Brian Eno, on a Mac.
description:
The Windows 95 startup sound was written by Brian Eno, on a Mac. He said: I have never used a PC in my life.

Ambient music pioneer commissioned by Microsoft designers Mark Malamud and Erik Gavriluk.

The brief asked for music that was inspiring, optimistic, futuristic and sentimental. And it had to be 3.25 seconds long.

How many short compositions Eno wrote for that one sound.

The sound has since been preserved by the Library of Congress. It was added to the National Recording Registry in 2025.

One of the most heard sounds in computing came from eighty four tries.
